title: Chalkboard Big Strokes
engine: custom DOM and Canvas tracing runtime with shared QLOBE audio, narration, timer, and debug modules
shareTitle: Chalkboard Big Strokes — Sweep, Sparkle, Erase!
description: Choose a wave, loop, star, or giant S; sweep it across a tactile toy chalkboard; then grab the felt eraser and wipe the slate clean.
learningGoals: Build shoulder and arm control through oversized pre-writing gestures
Practice continuous curves, crossing loops, corners, and letter-S formation
Develop confidence by erasing and replaying without penalties
interactionModel: choose one of four large raster mode plaques, trace a forgiving ordered path with one pointer, then drag a broad felt eraser across the completed chalk mark
feedbackModel: the start point glows, the finger lays down a dusty colored chalk trail, gentle misses simply invite another try, completion adds chalk sparkles and spoken praise, and erasing visibly clears the board

modes.title: Loop
modes.skill: continuous circular motion and midline crossing
